source: Current unchanged ticket03 prescribed pair evidence; excludes historical experiments

anchors.uncertainty: Wide extrapolation, not a bound. Unknown compile keys/failures; 8192 token memory/reference costs are extrapolated from prescribed 2048 pair checks. A still-live GPU hang is unbounded.
assumptions: Same physical UUID/PCI and exact toolchain; warmup5/iters101; cosine gate0.1.

Observed independent pair harness includes initial imports, reference preparation, actual compilation/cache, warmup and normal profiling plus additional synchronized diagnostics. It is an intentionally conservative upper comparator, not repeated identical normal-attempt cost.

Lower rate is an optimistic warmed normal-attempt hypothesis after one-time imports/aux builds; not independently measured. Upper rate includes cold key preparation/compilation and failed attempts based on retained focused pair elapsed observations.

Search uses initially empty dedicated default-configuration FlyDSL cache shared across sequential full/prune/staged invocations; keys compiled by earlier required searches stay warm. Auxiliary AITER JIT cache is already warm.

Each full start writes this range and exact current configuration before GPU startup. Actual elapsed/attempt progress updates and final cost-after-full retained; no hard task deadline or scope reduction.
